title: 極紫外金屬氧化物光阻研究
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究吸收與反應路徑、塗膜與表面、曝光與統計、轉移與驗證；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: absorption and reaction, coating and surfaces, exposure and statistics, transfer and validation. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

stages.title: 吸收與反應路徑
stages.description: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

steps.title: 畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈
steps.titleEn: Trace photons to changed solubility
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
steps.instruction: 畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。附上帶材料、方向與尺度標記的示意圖，圈出一處不能由圖單獨推論的量。最後以「吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。」檢查推論是否超出證據。
steps.instructionEn: Trace photons to changed solubility. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events.
steps.observation: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
steps.observationEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Trace photons to changed solubility", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Absorption and chemical conversion are different events." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 吸收與反應路徑的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and reaction: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

quiz.question: 完成「畫出光子到溶解度的因果鏈」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Trace photons to changed solubility", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。
吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。
相同厚度就表示化學組成相同。

Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.
Equal thickness proves equal chemical composition.
quiz.explanation: 吸收與化學轉換不是同一事件。 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorption and chemical conversion are different events. Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

steps.title: 以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減
steps.titleEn: Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film.
steps.instruction:
以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減。先讀本步來源，標出其實際材料、圖形或工具適用範圍，再以教學草圖或明確假設資料完成任務。建立因果與量測對照表，區分直接觀測、模型推論與尚需額外證據的結論。最後以「Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。」檢查推論是否超出證據。

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設均勻膜的吸收係數 α=0.020 nm⁻¹、厚度 t=20 nm、入射光子數 100。計算 T=exp(-αt)=0.6703，約 67.0 個等效光子穿透、33.0 個被吸收；厚度改為 40 nm 時吸收比例為 55.1%。比較吸收增加與實際化學轉換兩件事，不能由此計算單獨宣告感度或缺陷率。
steps.instructionEn:
Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Build a cause–measurement table separating direct observations, model inferences and conclusions needing more evidence. Finally check your inference against this principle: Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a uniform-film absorption coefficient α=0.020 nm⁻¹, thickness t=20 nm and 100 incident equivalent photons. T=exp(-αt)=0.6703 gives 67.0 transmitted and 33.0 absorbed. At 40 nm, absorption becomes 55.1%. Separate increased absorption from chemical conversion; this calculation alone establishes neither sensitivity nor defect rate.
steps.observation:
Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
結果須有 33.0% 與 55.1%，並註明反應產率尚未量測。
steps.observationEn:
Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 33.0% and 55.1%, explicitly noting that reaction yield is unmeasured.
steps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check:
交付「以假設吸收係數計算厚度衰減」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「Beer–Lambert 模型須標明均勻薄膜假設。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
本例驗收：結果須有 33.0% 與 55.1%，並註明反應產率尚未量測。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Calculate attenuation using an assumed absorption coefficient", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Beer–Lambert modeling assumes a uniform film." and retain one limitation.
Example acceptance: Report 33.0% and 55.1%, explicitly noting that reaction yield is unmeasured.

steps.observation: 批次差異不能全歸因於曝光機。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

steps.failure: 若報告假設「吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
steps.failureEn: If the report assumes "Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
steps.check: 交付「建立配方批次與量測追溯表」的圖表或計算、採用來源、假設與單位；說明本步結論「批次差異不能全歸因於曝光機。」可由哪些證據支持，並保留一項限制。
steps.checkEn: Submit the diagram, table or calculation for "Build a formulation-batch measurement ledger", with sources, assumptions and units. Identify evidence supporting "Batch variation cannot all be attributed to the scanner." and retain one limitation.

knowledge.title: 本步技術判讀
knowledge.text: 批次差異不能全歸因於曝光機。
knowledge.textEn: Batch variation cannot all be attributed to the scanner.

knowledge.title: 吸收與反應路徑的原理與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Absorption and reaction: principle and limits
knowledge.text: 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.

quiz.question: 完成「建立配方批次與量測追溯表」後，哪項判讀可靠？
quiz.questionEn: After "Build a formulation-batch measurement ledger", which interpretation is defensible?
options: 吸收更多就必定具有較低缺陷。
相同厚度就表示化學組成相同。
批次差異不能全歸因於曝光機。
optionsEn: Greater absorption necessarily guarantees fewer defects.
Equal thickness proves equal chemical composition.
Batch variation cannot all be attributed to the scanner.
quiz.explanation: 批次差異不能全歸因於曝光機。 金屬氧化物光阻的吸收、配體反應與不溶化必須分開驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Batch variation cannot all be attributed to the scanner. Absorption, ligand reactions and insolubilization require separate evidence in metal-oxide resists.
